program_overview: 36-Week Workforce Development, Skilled Trades & National Certification Preparation Program
Plan It. Measure It. Build It. Inspect It. Master the Trade. Build Your Future.

The 36-Week Construction Technology Program is a comprehensive career and technical education and workforce-development program designed to prepare students for entry-level employment, apprenticeships, postsecondary technical education, industry credentials, and applicable construction certification examinations.

Students progress from construction fundamentals into residential and commercial construction applications while developing competency in safety, mathematics, tools, blueprint reading, building systems, structural construction, estimating, project management, sustainability, and career readiness.
